capability: Search in the admin: the admin's own search, which finds its pages, records, settings and installed apps from one field, with its lists' search, filters and saved views (Shopify: Search, Search the app, saved views; Zid: Search / بحث; Salla: quick search, ميزة البحث في إعدادات المتجر)
note: Made by the coordinator from the held pass (held/new.tsv, N01, 31 October; held/new-proposals.md). Its places of its own: Zid's dashboard route search, titled بحث (zid/structures/dashboard-route-manifest/items.jsonl line 413, other-product-class@0d79b794f; ZD-5:216), and the Shopify app's tab 'Search the app' (TabNavigationScreen.SearchTab.tab, structures/shopify/mobile-app-navigation/tabs-and-more/items.jsonl line 44, observed-sh@e38dc17e3; SH-80:69). Joined across platforms, a reading: Shopify's search, which finds 'admin pages, resources, settings, and installed apps from one seamless flow' (SH-36:101), Zid's sidebar Search with 'Ctrl + K' (ZD-5's notes) and Salla's 'Use ⌘ + F for quick search' (SA-23:3) are one thing; Shopify's saved views are part of it, since its own post puts 'Filters, search, and saved views ... in one bar' (SH-35:24). Salla's plan line for search in the store's settings (SA-S-2087) joins on role, a reading. Not CM-SFR-013, buyers' search on the storefront; not CM-CUS-002's customer saved searches (Shopify's segments). A list's search of one kind of record (Salla's order_search, customer_search and product_search permissions, Zid's customers page, WooCommerce's order search indexes) is cited here as shows; where it is core on that record's capability, it counts once there.

Joined across platforms, a reading: Salla's Merchant API folder Order Histories (SA-S-1018) and Zid's plan line Order Update History (ZD-I-0272) are an order's recorded history, as Shopify's events on an order are; both are also cited as core on CM-ORD-001 (C-anchor, C-zid), from before this capability. Q1 left Shopify's Timeline events unplaced (SH-I-0026, 'cross-resource activity log (events and comments on other resources); its placement follows the resources it records'). Not CM-TRU-003, the audit log of staff activity, nor CM-OPS-005, the store's technical logs; a log of one kind of change kept by its own capability (inventory, CM-INV-002; shipments, CM-SHP-002) stays there. No parent: Shopify's Timeline events is a top-level group of its API's reference, and Salla's Order Histories a top-level folder of its Merchant API, beside Products and Employees (parentId 841841 for each).
